description: Block suspicious network commands (curl/wget to scripts, unauthorized hosts)

PreToolUse.command: INPUT=$(echo '$TOOL_INPUT' | jq -r '.command // empty'); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '(curl|wget).*\.(sh|py|rb|pl|bat|ps1)'; then echo "BLOCKED: Downloading executable scripts is not allowed" && exit 1; fi; if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '(curl|wget).*(-o|-O|>)'; then echo "BLOCKED: Downloading files requires explicit approval" && exit 1; fi; exit 0

usage: Copy this template to .claude/settings.json. Customize the patterns to match your security policy. Add a whitelist of allowed domains if needed.
